resources.string: The PC was not (or no longer) reachable.
Moves photos and videos that are verifiably backed up on the PC to the gallery trash. Before that LeoSync checks every file on the PC. Whatever is missing there or different stays.
The check after upload is set to “Off” for this profile. Unchecked photos are not offered here. Set at least “Low” in the profile; newly backed-up photos appear from the next sync on.
Deletes files on the phone that are verifiably unchanged on the PC. They are kept on the PC. Folder files do not go to a trash, they are deleted directly after the check.
Photos marked as favorite in the gallery stay on the phone.
Android can only report favorites from version 11.

resources.string: Check on the PC and move to trash
Check on the PC and delete
Files in the gallery trash can be restored for 30 days.
Live photos (image + video) are only removed together.

LeoSync checks every file on the PC (present, same size, same content) and then deletes it permanently from the phone (%1$s). They are kept on the PC. Whatever is missing there or different stays on the phone.

plurals.item: Android 10 has no trash. %1$s file will be permanently deleted from the phone. It is present on the PC.
Android 10 has no trash. %1$s files will be permanently deleted from the phone. They are present on the PC.

resources.string: “%1$s” = everything that fits none of the groups.
One pattern per line. Matching files always stay on the phone.
Examples: *.kdbx (all files with this extension), Important/** (everything in the folder “Important”), Thumbs.db
No file matches, or none is backed up on the PC yet. Relax the selection or sync first.
Android 10 has no trash: files are permanently deleted from the phone.
